critical_steps: Each Lambda_j is invertible, bounded below, and has norm tending to one while its minimum modulus tends to zero.
The unscaled g-frame energy is exactly a diagonal quadratic form with bounds 16/15 and 47/30.
D_j Lambda_j equals alpha_j I, so the scaled family is exactly tight with bound 1/3.
The block norms satisfy ||D_j||=2^j, so the ambient block diagonal operator is unbounded.
The published proof step confuses lower singular information with the operator norm.
integrity.proof_basis: Exact diagonal operators on l2 with closed-form geometric sums.
integrity.unproved_limits: No universal weakest replacement hypothesis for global block boundedness is asserted.

scientific_limitations: The finding corrects the bounded-block necessity in Ahmadi--Rahimi Proposition 3.1 and its K-g-frame extension in Kumar--Malhotra--Khanna Theorem 24.
No weakest possible extra hypothesis guaranteeing global boundedness of the ambient block diagonal operator is claimed.
The surrounding range-restricted scaling criteria are not contradicted.
A nonindexed correction or informal author note may contain the same counterexample.
title: Operator norms do not control block scaling of a \(g\)-frame
